QuestInfo.name: Patricia's Flat Stomach
QuestInfo.0: Cute teddy bear Patricia is worried about something. Go find out what.
QuestInfo.1: Patricia doesn't believe she is a lovable teddy bear because her stomach is too flat. You too think a round belly is proper a teddy bear so you decide to get her the #r#t4009079##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've brought the cotton to fill Patricia's flat stomach.

0.0: The biggest appeal of a teddy bear is its round belly! But look at mine, mine's way too flat! How am I supposed to be loved with such a flat tummy? I'm going to be forgotten at this rate, so can you help me out?

yes.0: My body's full of cotton, so I need more #r#t4009079##k to fill my tummy. I'll probably need #r20#k of them to make mine round.

1.0: Did you get me more cotton?

yes.0: Now I am the cutest teddy bear in the world!

default.0: I need about #r20#k #r#t4009079##k items to make my tummy round.
